mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM OVERDUE o JOIN USER u ON o.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND o.status = 'Y' ) THEN CONCAT('이용불가(~', (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(o2.endDate), '%Y.%m.%d') FROM OVERDUE o2 JOIN USER u2 ON o2.uidx = u2.uidx WHERE u2.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND o2.status = 'Y' ), ')') ELSE '이용가능' END AS loanStatus FROM USER u WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber}

SELECT l.lidx, @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS rownum, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, DATE_FORMAT(l.loanDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS loanDate, DATE_FORMAT(l.dueDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS dueDate, CASE WHEN l.returnDate IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(l.returnDate, '%Y.%m.%d') ELSE '-' END AS returnDate, l.status, l.extended FROM LOAN l JOIN USER u ON l.uidx = u.uidx JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS lb ON l.lbidx = lb.lbidx JOIN BOOKS b ON lb.bidx = b.bidx CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rownum := 0) AS r WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND l.delyn = 'N' ORDER BY l.loanDate DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOAN l JOIN USER u ON l.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber}

SELECT r.ridx, @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS rownum, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, DATE_FORMAT(r.reservationDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS reservationDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.pickupDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS pickupDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.dueDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS dueDate, r.status FROM RESERVATION r JOIN USER u ON r.uidx = u.uidx JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS lb ON r.lbidx = lb.lbidx JOIN BOOKS b ON lb.bidx = b.bidx CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rownum := 0) AS rnum WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} ORDER BY r.reservationDate DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION R JOIN USER u ON R.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber}
SELECT MIN(pickupDate) FROM RESERVATION WHERE lbidx = #{lbidx} AND delyn = 'N' AND status IN ('예약중','예약대기')
